title: Make ticket creation safe to retry after a lost response
description: A browser POST can create a ticket even when its response is lost. Add an idempotency key to each ticket-create submission, persist it with the created ticket, and make same-key retries return the original ticket. Reusing a key with a different payload must fail with a conflict. Keep the key stable while the same create form draft is retried.
why: A manual retry after an uncertain POST can currently create a duplicate ticket; the owner decided this must be fixed before the first npm release.

acceptance.text: The browser reuses one stable idempotency key when the same create draft is submitted again
A same-key same-payload retry returns the original ticket without adding a second ticket, including after the server restarts
Reusing a key with a different payload returns a conflict and leaves ticket data unchanged
Core/API and HTTP tests cover retries, conflicting payloads and concurrent duplicates

todos.text: Add a validated optional request key and canonical payload fingerprint to ticket creation
Make the create write and persisted request metadata atomic and replay-safe
Pass a stable key from the browser create form and retain it after an uncertain failure
Add core/API/HTTP tests for replay, mismatch, restart and concurrency
Update release docs and verify the complete test suite

outcome.summary: Added replay-safe ticket creation with persisted request keys, browser session recovery, conflict handling, and core/HTTP coverage.
